name: MedSP1000
intro: MedSP1000 是由标准化病人教学案例转化而来的交互式临床 Agent 评测基准，包含 1,638 个标准化病人案例和 24,602 条轨迹级同行评审 rubric。每轮评测中，临床 Agent 与病人 Agent 和环境控制器闭环交互，并按原始材料中的专家标准进行过程级评分。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
build_method: 标准化病人案例改造, 专家rubric, 交互式仿真
task_type: 医疗Agent任务, 临床对话, 过程级评估
eval_feature: 动态临床决策, 信息收集, 治疗规划, 纵向管理
task_type_en: Medical agent task, Clinical dialogue, Process-level evaluation
build_method_en: Standardized patient case adaptation, Expert Rubrics, Interactive Simulation
eval_feature_en: Dynamic clinical decision-making, Information gathering, Treatment planning, Longitudinal management
intro_en: MedSP1000 is an SP-derived interactive benchmark for clinical-agent evaluation, containing 1,638 standardized patient cases and 24,602 trajectory-level peer-reviewed rubrics. In each run, a clinical agent interacts in a closed loop with a patient agent and an environment controller, and is scored throughout the encounter against expert criteria from the original materials.
